blocks.title: 📰 2. 🏛️ REGULATORY BODIES NEWS
blocks.text: 🪝 NABARD Facilitates GI Registration for 28 New Products (Total 176 Supported). Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: Expands GI tagging for indigenous craft and agri-products across Bihar, Assam, and MP.
New GI Products: Nalanda Bawanbuti Saree (Bihar), Gaya Pattharkatti Stone Craft (Bihar), Kuchai Silk (Jharkhand), Ba Shilp & Bihu Pepa (Assam), Khajuraho Metal Craft (MP).
NABARD Total: NABARD has supported 176 total products in obtaining GI tags.
GI products in this round (28) vs total NABARD-supported GI products (176).
🎯 Exam Angle → Focus on statutory circular guidelines, compliance deadlines, penal provisions, and applicability thresholds across scheduled banks.
